Liam O'Connor: Proposed asks: 1) one-time adjustment to remove the replayed window charges, 2) 90-day blended committed pricing option, 3) itemized meter logs + proof of data hashes. If they decline, open RFQ with QuotaFlow and MeterWave.

Billing-bot: Reminder: Contract PULSE-2024-L1 expires in 32 days. Suggested action: start renewal workflow (/start_renewal PULSE-2024-L1).

Priya Nair: Finance: pre-approve goodwill credits up to $7,500. Anything larger needs FP&A sign-off. Also need GL codes for disputed lines.

Hannah Reed: Legal can draft dispute notice referencing the test-exclusion clause. Recommend we request a short addendum preventing vendor billing for scheduled infra tests.

Liam O'Connor: I'll draft the email to PulseTally and attach our job logs. Will post draft here before sending.
